metadata.title: Eribulin Monotherapy – 28 day
metadata.indication: Locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer after progression on at least one chemotherapy regimen for advanced disease; prior anthracycline and taxane in the adjuvant or metastatic setting unless unsuitable.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled rule encoding · independent clinical and oncology pharmacy review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: Current NCCP source checked including indications, schedule, eligibility, independent partial inputs, recurrence dose ladder, organ impairment, cardiac exclusions and monitoring. Source gaps remain explicit review.

metadata.schedule_summary: Eribulin 1.23 mg/m² (base) on days 1 and 15, every 28 days; continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity.
audited_eligibility: Locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer after progression on at least one chemotherapy regimen for advanced disease; prior anthracycline and taxane in the adjuvant or metastatic setting unless unsuitable.
audit_limitations: Independent consultant and oncology pharmacy validation pending; source reconciliation is not clinical-use authorisation.
Renal/hepatic percentages refer to the original dose; prior reductions and competing pathways require specialist reconciliation.
NCCP cycle-start blood tests supplemented by EMA SmPC FBC before every dose; ECG is risk-triggered, not a universal fixed-cycle schedule.
The 28-day posology is unlicensed in Ireland: patient information/consent and local Drugs and Therapeutics Committee acknowledgement apply.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision support reconciled to current NCCP 00743, footer version 3, on 18 October 2026. Independent clinical and pharmacy review remains pending. Confirm the current PDF and patient-specific plan.
clinical_governance.unlicensed_posology_note: 28-day schedule is an unlicensed posology in Ireland; informed consent and local DTC acknowledgement required.

indications.description: Locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer after progression on at least one chemotherapy regimen for advanced disease; prior anthracycline and taxane in the adjuvant or metastatic setting unless unsuitable.

treatment.schedule_summary: Eribulin 1.23 mg/m² (base) on days 1 and 15, every 28 days; continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity.
treatment.dose_basis: eribulin base, not the 1.4 mg/m² mesylate salt convention
treatment.duration: Until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity
treatment.optional_combination_note: NCCP permits combination with trastuzumab under regimen 00200. This monotherapy card does not automatically add trastuzumab doses or monitoring; select and coordinate its separate protocol.

administration.notes: Dose is eribulin base. Do not dilute in glucose 5%. No home infusion pump is used.

eligibility: Locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer after progression on at least one chemotherapy regimen for advanced disease; prior anthracycline and taxane in the adjuvant or metastatic setting unless unsuitable.

baseline: FBC, renal and liver profile (NCCP p2)
Potassium, calcium and magnesium: correct low levels before treatment (EMA SmPC §4.4; NCCP00743 p4)
ECG when heart failure, bradyarrhythmia, QT-prolonging medicines or electrolyte abnormalities are present (NCCP p2)
regular: FBC, renal and liver profile at the start of each cycle (NCCP p2)
FBC before every eribulin dose, including day 15 (EMA SmPC §4.4); confirm treatment-day counts and toxicity before dosing
Periodic potassium, calcium and magnesium; ECG when risk factors or clinical indications require it
Assess neuropathy, infection, mucositis and other toxicity before each dose
monitoring.disease: Scans and other response tests follow the consultant treatment plan. These sources do not mandate a fixed CT, tumour-marker, echo or DXA interval.
monitoring.additional_therapy: If trastuzumab is separately prescribed, add its own cardiac imaging and scheduling plan; this is not routine eribulin-only monitoring.

dose_modifications: Delay dosing for ANC <1 ×10⁹/L, platelets <75 ×10⁹/L or current grade 3–4 non-haematological toxicity.
Qualifying toxicity after treatment: 1.23 → 0.97 mg/m²; recurrence despite 0.97 → 0.62 mg/m²; recurrence despite 0.62: consider discontinuation. Do not re-escalate.
Renal/hepatic recommendations are relative to original dose, not compounded sequential reductions. Confirm individual dose and previous reductions with oncology pharmacy.
